house_fundamentals.what: House fundamentals (lean, incumbency, fundraising) fit on one midterm, scored on the other given its national environment

statewide_polls.what: this model's polling average, as of 3 days out, vs. results: every Senate and governor race 2014-2024 with a poll and a Republican vs non-Republican result

fit.likelihood: Student t, 6 df (the simulator's race error)

national_error.note: sd of the national (cycle-level) polling miss, net of race-level noise; midterm-like = no presidential race (2014, 2018, 2022, 2025). Its sign is not modeled: see docs/method.md, Accuracy.

generic_ballot.what: generic-ballot average 3 days out vs the national two-party House vote and vs the fitted district baseline (the quantity the House model needs)
generic_ballot.source: FiveThirtyEight generic-ballot poll archive (CC BY 4.0) via the Internet Archive
